Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 dummy VARCHAR2(1);
 v_local_date DATE := SYSDATE; -- SCR 18938
BEGIN
 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_date);
 END IF;

 nullchk;

 SELECT SUBSTR(company,1,50)
 ,center_id
 INTO :control_block.company
 ,:control_block.center_id
 FROM contracts
 WHERE contract_id = :control_block.contract_id AND 
 --chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id AND --RP MLT# 263 06042018
 LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(:control_block.contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y' AND
 contract_type = 'RG' AND 
 EXISTS 
 (
 SELECT 'x' 
 FROM rgt_result_parms rgt 
 WHERE rgt.contract_id = contracts.contract_id AND
 --rgt.chapter_id = contracts.chapter_id AND -- V03
 rgt.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id AND -- V03
 under_extract_flag = 'N'
 ) AND 
 v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE+365)
 ;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS 
 THEN
 show_error('1060');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND 
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x'
 INTO dummy
 FROM contracts
 WHERE LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y' AND
 --chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id AND --RP MLT# 263 06042018 
 UPPER(company) LIKE '%'||UPPER(:control_block.contract_id)||'%' AND 
 v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE+365) AND 
 EXISTS 
 (
 SELECT 'x' 
 FROM rgt_result_parms rgt
 WHERE rgt.contract_id= contracts.contract_id AND
 --rgt.chapter_id = contracts.chapter_id AND -- V03
 rgt.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id AND -- V03 
 under_extract_flag = 'N'
 ) AND 
 ROWNUM = 1
 ;
 LIST_VALUES;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 -- this is to force a check or validation
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN 
 BELL;
 show_error('1147');
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN 
 handle_error;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
-- Added by Kishore on 03/29/2012. IM 7967
declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if :Global.Error_count ='N' then 
 :Global.Error_count:='Y';
 if error_code in (50002, 50003, 50004, -- invalid date
 50011, 50012, 50021, 50023, 50025, 50026, 0) then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK), 1, 2)) = 'FX' then
 disp_format_mask := substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask := get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022', disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50017, 50018, 50019, 50022) then -- invalid time
 show_error('5016');
 end if;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
end;
-- End of change

ProgramUnit.Name: INIT_EXTRACT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure init_extract is
 szExtrLoc VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
 program_name VARCHAR2(60) := NULL;
 in_file Text_IO.File_Type;
 t_file_name VARCHAR2(200);
 t_pp_id varchar2(4);
 t_status varchar2(200);
 t_local_time date;
 lv_report_id VARCHAR2(20); -- SCR 19037
 v_after_time_gmt DATE; -- SCR 19037
 lv_pp_id VARCHAR2(10);
--
begin
 -- Added by Kishore on 03/27/2012. IM 7967
 t_local_time := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 -- End of change

 -- Get the log file directory
 t_file_name := :control_block.result_parm_id || '_' || :control_block.chapter_id || '_' ||
 :control_block.contract_id || '_' || substr(to_char(sysdate, 'hh24miss'), -4) || '.ext';
 

 update rgt_result_parms
 set under_extract_flag = 'Y'
 where result_parm_id = :control_block.result_parm_id
 and chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 
 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 01/26/2012
 if nvl(:control_block.after_time, (sysdate - 1)) > sysdate then -- Added by Kishore on 01/18/2011
 INITEXTRACT.schedule_extracts(t_file_name, :control_block.after_time); -- Added by Kishore on 01/18/2011
 else
 INITEXTRACT.main_proc(t_file_name); 
 end if;
 -- End of commented section */
 

 -- SCR 19037 -- RSM report auto generation. This is used for both immediate and scheduled extract. -- IM 99
 IF NVL(:control_block.rsm_auto_report,'N') = 'Y' THEN
 select to_char(systimestamp, 'SSFF2') into lv_pp_id
 from dual;

 fpk_rsm_auto_report.gl_report_id := :control_block.contract_id || '_' || lv_pp_id; 
 lv_report_id := fpk_rsm_auto_report.gl_report_id; 
 END IF; 


 if nvl(:control_block.after_time, (t_local_time - 1)) > t_local_time then -- Added by Kishore on 03/27/2012. IM 7967

 -- SCR 19037
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, :control_block.after_time, v_after_time_gmt);
 ELSE
 v_after_time_gmt := :control_block.after_time;
 END IF;

 -- Added by Kishore on 03/27/2012. IM 7967
 begin
 insert into rgt_schedule_extract
 (file_name,
 extract_date_time,
 status,
 chapter_id,
 contract_id,
 result_parm_id,
 gen_report, -- SCR 19037
 report_id ) -- SCR 19037 )
 values
 (t_file_name,
 :control_block.after_time,
 null,
 :global.chapter_id,
 :control_block.contract_id,
 :control_block.result_parm_id,
 :control_block.rsm_auto_report, -- SCR 19037
 lv_report_id); -- SCR 19037 );
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 
 
 -- SCR 19037 -- RSM report auto generation -- IM 99
 IF NVL(:control_block.rsm_auto_report,'N') = 'Y' THEN
 -- 1) initialize variables related to RSM report.
 fpk_rsm_auto_report.init(v_after_time_gmt); 
 message('Batch is submitted for re-extraction and RSM report is scheduled.', NO_ACKNOWLEDGE);
 ELSE
 message('Batch is submitted for re-extraction.', NO_ACKNOWLEDGE);
 END IF; 
 
 
 -- End of change
 else -- Added by Kishore on 03/27/2012. IM 7967
 -- Added by Kishore on 01/18/2012
 begin
 select to_char(systimestamp, 'SSFF2') 
 into t_pp_id
 from dual;
 end;
 
 rgprextr.main_program(:control_block.result_parm_id,
 :global.chapter_id,
 :control_block.contract_id,
 t_pp_id,
 t_status);
 --end if; -- if nvl(:control_block.after_time, (sysdate - 1)) > sysdate then
 
 if t_status is not null then
 message('Error: ' || t_status);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 -- End of change
 
 -- SCR 19307 -- RSM AUTO REPORT GENERATION
 IF NVL(:control_block.rsm_auto_report,'N') = 'Y' THEN
 -- 1) initialize variables related to RSM report.
 fpk_rsm_auto_report.init;
 -- 2) call rsm_report.pop_table db routine. 
 fpk_rsm_auto_report.populate_table; 
 -- 3) Generate report.
 fpk_rsm_auto_report.generate;
 END IF;
 
 -- SCR 19037 -- RSM report auto generation -- IM 99
 IF NVL(:control_block.rsm_auto_report,'N') = 'Y' THEN
 message('Batch is submitted for re-extraction and RSM report is generated.', NO_ACKNOWLEDGE);
 ELSE
 message('Batch is submitted for re-extraction.', NO_ACKNOWLEDGE);
 END IF; 
 --
 end if; 
 --host (command);
 -- host(program_name||'/RGPREXTR.x'||' '||:control_block.result_parm_id ||' '|| :control_block.chapter_id ||' '|| :control_block.contract_id ||' '||'7500');
 --message('Batch is submitted for Re extraction'); -- IM 99
 
exception
 when form_trigger_failure then
 raise;
 when others then 
 Text_IO.Fclose (in_file); 
 message (sqlerrm);pause; 
end;

PROCEDURE get_details 
IS
 d_count NUMBER(5) ;
 v_local_date DATE := SYSDATE; -- SCR 18938
BEGIN
 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_date);
 END IF;
 
 BEGIN
 
 /* -- Added in post-query -- V03
 -- Get the latest contract tests image **
 SELECT profile_seq_no 
 INTO :batch.profile_seq_no
 FROM batch_inputs
 WHERE LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y' AND
 --chapter_id= :control_block.chapter_id AND MLT# 491
 contract_id = :control_block.contract_id AND 
 batch_id = :batch.batch_id;
 */
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '5';
 
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(1) 
 INTO d_count
 FROM CONTRACT_TESTS_IMAGE
 WHERE --chapter_id= :control_block.chapter_id AND -- V03
 contract_id = :control_block.contract_id AND 
 profile_seq_no = :batch.profile_seq_no AND 
 profile_set_id = :batch.profile_set_id AND -- V03
 v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE+365)
 ;
 IF d_count = 0 
 THEN
 show_error('2331');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND 
 THEN
 show_error('2331');
 check_package_failure;
 END ;

 GO_BLOCK('popt');
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 GO_BLOCK('batch');
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '0';
 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND 
 THEN
 NULL;
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN
 handle_error;
 END;

 -- END of Fetching contract tests **
 :GLOBAL.units_found := 'N';
 GO_BLOCK('units');
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '5';
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '0';

 IF :units.unit_id IS NOT NULL 
 THEN
 :GLOBAL.units_found := 'Y';
 END IF;

 GO_BLOCK('batch');
END;

 PROCEDURE generate;

 -- report parameters.

ProgramUnit.Name: FPK_RSM_AUTO_REPORT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE BODY fpk_rsm_auto_report IS
 /* SCR 19037 */
 PROCEDURE init(pl_start_time IN DATE) IS
 
 ld_sysdate DATE;
 lv_pp_id VARCHAR2(10);
 
 PROCEDURE ins_upd_rpt_parm(pl_report_id IN VARCHAR2) IS
 ncount NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 SELECT NVL(COUNT(*),0) INTO ncount 
 FROM rpt_parm 
 WHERE appl_id = gc_appl_id AND 
 user_name = gl_user AND 
 report_name = gc_rep_name AND 
 parm_id = pl_report_id;
 
 IF ncount = 0 THEN 
 INSERT INTO rpt_parm 
 (
 APPL_ID
 ,USER_NAME
 ,REPORT_NAME 
 ,PARM_ID 
 ,PARM_DATE 
 ,SUBMIT_DATE 
 ,REPORT_STATUS
 ,START_TIME
 )
 VALUES
 (
 gc_appl_id
 ,gl_user
 ,gc_rep_name
 ,pl_report_id
 ,SYSDATE
 ,SYSDATE
 ,'S' -- NULL -- IM 99 
 , pl_start_time
 );
 ELSE
 UPDATE rpt_parm 
 SET submit_date = SYSDATE,
 report_status = 'S' -- IM 99 
 WHERE appl_id = gc_appl_id AND 
 user_name = gl_user AND 
 report_name = gc_rep_name AND 
 parm_id = pl_report_id;
 END IF;
 
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN 
 MESSAGE('Loc-->1 :'||SQLERRM); PAUSE;
 END ins_upd_rpt_parm; 
 
 PROCEDURE ins_rpt_parm_select(pno_in IN VARCHAR2, pselect_in IN VARCHAR2, pcode_in IN VARCHAR2) IS
 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO rpt_parm_select
 (
 APPL_ID
 ,USER_NAME
 ,REPORT_NAME 
 ,PARM_ID 
 ,PARM_NO 
 ,PARM_SELECT 
 ,PARM_CODE 
 )
 VALUES
 (
 gc_appl_id
 ,gl_user
 ,gc_rep_name
 ,gl_report_id
 ,pno_in
 ,pselect_in
 ,pcode_in
 ); 
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN 
 MESSAGE('Loc--2 :'|| pcode_in || '-' ||SQLERRM);PAUSE;
 END ins_rpt_parm_select; 
 
 BEGIN
 
 -- 1) USER
 SELECT DECODE(SUBSTR(:banner.user_id, 1, 4) , 'OPS$', 
 SUBSTR(:banner.user_id, 5), :banner.user_id) 
 INTO gl_user
 FROM DUAL;
 
 -- 2) Contract ID
 gl_contract_id := :control_block.contract_id;
 
 -- 3) Result Parm ID
 gl_result_parm_id := :CONTROL_BLOCK.RESULT_PARM_ID;

 -- 4) File Name
 ld_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE); -- new tz function
 gl_filename := gl_result_parm_id || '_' || gl_contract_id || '_' || TO_CHAR(ld_sysdate, 'MMDDHHMI') || '.pdf'; 
 

 -- Insert or Update rpt_parm
 ins_upd_rpt_parm(pl_report_id => gl_report_id); 
 
 -- 5) Chapter ID 
 gl_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID;
 
 
 -- Parameters 
 ins_rpt_parm_select(pno_in => '1', pselect_in => gl_result_parm_id, pcode_in => 'RPARM');

 ins_rpt_parm_select(pno_in => '2', pselect_in => 'ALL', pcode_in => 'RBAT');
 gl_batch_id := 'ALL';
 
 ins_rpt_parm_select(pno_in => '3', pselect_in => 'ALL', pcode_in => 'RUNIT');
 gl_unit_id := 'ALL';

 ins_rpt_parm_select(pno_in => '4', pselect_in => 'ALL', pcode_in => 'RTEST');
 gl_test_id := 'ALL';

 ins_rpt_parm_select(pno_in => '5', pselect_in => 'ALL', pcode_in => 'REAC');
 gl_result_status := 'ALL';
 
 -- 11) -- Testing Facility
 -- IM 99
 DECLARE
 CURSOR lab_id_cur IS
 SELECT vtl.testing_lab_id
 FROM master_codes mc, valid_testing_labs vtl
 WHERE mc.code_type = 'TLABS'
 AND mc.code = vtl.testing_lab_id
 AND vtl.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND ld_sysdate BETWEEN mc.eff_date AND NVL(mc.term_date, ld_sysdate+1)
 AND ld_sysdate BETWEEN vtl.eff_date AND NVL(vtl.term_date, ld_sysdate+1); 
 BEGIN 
 fpk_rsm_auto_report.gl_testing_facility := NULL;
 
 OPEN lab_id_cur;
 FETCH lab_id_cur INTO fpk_rsm_auto_report.gl_testing_facility;
 CLOSE lab_id_cur;
 
 IF fpk_rsm_auto_report.gl_testing_facility IS NULL THEN
 show_error('1069');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END;
 -- IM 99

 ins_rpt_parm_select(pno_in => '4', pselect_in => gl_testing_facility, pcode_in => 'LABID');

 
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL:=10;
 COMMIT;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL:=0; 
 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN form_trigger_failure THEN
 raise;
 
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 MESSAGE('init -' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 100), NO_ACKNOWLEDGE); 
 END init;

 PROCEDURE generate IS
 filename varchar2(1000);
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dest_parm'; 
 
 --for Apps server 
 report_id Report_Object;
 ReportServerJob VARCHAR2(100);
 vc_rep_status VARCHAR2(100);
 vjob_id VARCHAR2(100);
 
 -- Multiple reports server changes; -- Added by Kishore on 10/22/2013
 l_svr_name VARCHAR2(70);
 l_err_msg VARCHAR2(200);
 -- End of change
 BEGIN

 BEGIN 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id) ;
 end if ;
 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF; 
 END; 
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 10/22/2013 to get least active jobs report server name.
 BC_CHECK_REPSERVER.get_reports_server(out_server_name => l_svr_name,
 out_error_msg => l_err_msg);
 
 IF l_err_msg IS NOT NULL THEN
 message('Err ' || l_err_msg);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 IF l_svr_name IS NULL THEN
 message('Error retrieving Server Name');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 
 
 
 
 report_id:= find_report_object('LTREPORTS');
 
 --Insert into RSM_RPT_PARM table
 INSERT INTO RSM_RPT_PARM(APPL_ID ,
 USER_NAME ,
 REPORT_NAME ,
 RESULT_PARM_ID ,
 REPORT_ID ,
 SUBMIT_DATE , 
 REPORT_STATUS ,
 REPORT_FILE_NAME ,
 PRINT_REQUEST_FLAG)
 VALUES (gc_appl_id, gl_user, gc_rep_name, gl_result_parm_id, gl_report_id, SYSDATE,'C',gl_filename, null);
 
 :SYSTEM.message_level:=10;
 COMMIT;
 :SYSTEM.message_level:=0;
 
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_FILENAME,lower(gc_rep_name)); --'vdrinter.rdf');
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_COMM_MODE,ASYNCHRONOUS);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_EXECUTION_MODE,BATCH);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESTYPE,file);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESNAME,gl_filename);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESFORMAT,'pdf');
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_SERVER,l_svr_name); 
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_OTHER, 'paramform=no');
 
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_PARM_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,gl_report_id) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'NO_OF_COPIES',TEXT_PARAMETER,1);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_CHAPTER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,nvl(gl_chapter_id,'WAD'));
 add_parameter(pl_id,'PRINT_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,NULL);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_TEST_LAB_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,gl_testing_facility);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,gl_report_id) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'RESULT_PARM',TEXT_PARAMETER,gl_result_parm_id);
 --add_parameter(pl_id,'HEADER_YN',TEXT_PARAMETER,:rpt_parm.header_and_trailer_flag);
 --add_parameter(pl_id,'DELETE_AFTER_PRINT_FLAG',TEXT_PARAMETER,:rpt_parm.delete_after_print_flag);
 --add_parameter(pl_id,'AUTO_PRINT_FLAG',TEXT_PARAMETER,:rpt_parm.auto_print_flag);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'RPT_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,upper(gc_rep_name));
 add_parameter(pl_id,'USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,upper(gl_user)); -- Added by Kishore on 05/16/2011
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_FILE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,gl_filename);
 
 ReportServerJob:=run_report_object(report_id,pl_id);
 vjob_id := substr(reportserverjob,length(l_svr_name)+2); -- Added by Kishore on 10/22/2013
 vc_rep_status := REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);
 
 
 update rpt_parm 
 set rep_job_id = vjob_id,
 rep_server = l_svr_name -- Added by Kishore on 10/22/2013 
 where upper(report_name) = upper(gc_rep_name)
 and user_name = gl_user
 and parm_id = gl_report_id;
 
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL:=15;
 COMMIT; 
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL:=0;
 
 SYNCHRONIZE;
 SET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(CURSOR_STYLE,'DEFAULT'); 

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 MESSAGE('Report Generate - ' || SQLERRM );PAUSE; 
 
 END generate;

END fpk_rsm_auto_report;

RecordGroup.Name: CONTROL_BLO_RESULT_PARM_LOV1
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT distinct result_parm_id, ins_date
FROM(
select result_parm_id, substr(to_char(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, insert_dats),'MM-DD-YY'),1,8) ins_date
from rgt_result_parms 
where contract_id = :control_block.contract_id 
and chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id 
and under_extract_flag = 'N' 
)
order by ins_date desc, result_parm_id

RecordGroup.Name: CONTROL_BLO_CONTRACT_ID_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select contract_id, substr(company, 1, 50), center_id
 from contracts
 where LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y'
 and (upper(company) like upper('%' || :control_block.contract_id || '%') or
 (contract_id like '%' || :control_block.contract_id || '%'))
 and contract_type = 'RG'
 and Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,
 sysdate) between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date, sysdate + 365)
 and exists (select 'x'
 from rgt_result_parms rgt
 where rgt.contract_id = contracts.contract_id
 and rgt.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and under_extract_flag = 'N')
 order by company
